columns.name: sku
columns.description: SKU addressing key; NOT NULL (PI2), part of the (sku, location) unique pair (PI1).

columns.name: location
columns.description: Location addressing key; NOT NULL (PI2), part of the (sku, location) unique pair (PI1).

columns.name: inventory_code
columns.description: Combined inventory code stored as filed (AC1/AC2); NOT NULL (PI2).

columns.name: quantity
columns.description: Stored stock level; NOT NULL (PI2), CHECK >= 0 (PI3).

schema_changes.detail: Create stock_records with columns id (uuid pk, default gen_random_uuid()), sku (text not null), location (text not null), inventory_code (text not null), quantity (integer not null), created_at (timestamptz not null default now()), updated_at (timestamptz not null default now()). Add composite unique constraint on (sku, location) and CHECK (quantity >= 0).
schema_changes.migration_note: Additive create only (PI5): upgrade creates the table + unique + check; downgrade drops the table. No existing table altered, so records created before this migration are preserved (R1). The (sku, location) unique constraint (PI1) plus a single-transaction read-then-upsert in the service (PI4) resolve write collisions in place (AC3).
